Done! Created `src/numbering.js` with `nextInvoiceNumber(existingNumbers, issueDate)` that generates numbers in format `INV-<year>-<counter>` with zero-padded 4-digit counters restarting each year.

Added `issueInvoice(invoice, existingNumbers)` to `src/invoices.js` that assigns the next number and changes status to 'issued'. Returns NOT_DRAFT if invoice isn't a draft.

Added 9 tests for `nextInvoiceNumber` covering year extraction, counter incrementing, multiple numbers, other-year filtering, padding, large counters, malformed numbers, and different years. Added 5 tests for `issueInvoice` covering numbering, counter incrementation, data preservation, NOT_DRAFT error, and immutability.

All 61 tests pass ✓
